description: Mark an EXISTING coupon as a creator's AFFILIATE code at an agreed commission % (the standing deal is 30% of first-year attributed revenue), or clear the mark with percent:null. WRITE, human-gated: a real write requires an elicitation-capable client and the human sees the code and the rate; dry_run works anywhere. From the moment the mark is set, every payment that checks out with the code (and every renewal of a subscription it opened) is recorded in the affiliate ledger at this %, frozen per payment -- so changing or clearing the rate later only affects FUTURE payments, and past months keep reporting what was agreed at the time. Clearing never deletes history. This does not change what buyers pay (that is the coupon's discount_percent) and does not pay anyone: read the owed figure with affiliate_commissions and pay by hand. Use list_coupons to see codes, create_coupon to mint one for a creator first.
name: set_coupon_affiliate
